> **ASIEXP (Advanced Spacesuit for Interstellar Exploration)** is a 3D-designed astronaut spacesuit concept created in Tinkercad. It features a spherical helmet with a gold-accented visor, a detailed chest panel, articulated gloves, reinforced-looking joints, specialised boots, and a rear life-support backpack. The design also incorporates the Indian flag and personalised identification markings. What makes ASIEXP mine is its distinctive combination of space-exploration styling, detailed front and rear components, and Indian identity. I designed it as a complete 360° model, paying attention to both the overall silhouette and smaller details such as the visor layers, finger shapes, boot treads, and backpack structure. ASIEXP represents my vision of what a spacesuit for future interstellar exploration could look like.

**15h**

I have completed modelling the basic body of my ASIEXP spacesuit in Tinkercad, establishing the overall structure and proportions of the suit. My next step is to design the specialised helmet and integrated life-support backpack, adding more details to make the concept look futuristic and suitable for imagining humanity’s future exploration beyond Earth.

I have completed the full 3D model of ASIEXP in Tinkercad, including the spacesuit body, specialised helmet and visor, integrated life-support backpack, and detailed components.
